item.title: Houthis Hit Saudi Arabia's Jazan Refinery, Killing One Worker, in Second Strike in Two Days
item.description: A Houthi projectile struck Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery on Thursday, killing a Nepalese worker and injuring several others, a day after the group claimed an attack on Ras Tanura, the kingdom's largest refinery.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Iranian Drone Attack on Kuwait Kills Two Italian Technicians Maintaining Air-Defence Radar
item.description: Iranian drones struck an air-defence detection station in Kuwait on Thursday, killing two Italian technicians maintaining Skyguard radar antennas and injuring two others, as Tehran denied any role in the attack.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: UK Net Migration Falls to 77,000, Its Lowest Level in Almost Three Decades
item.description: UK net migration fell to an estimated 77,000 in the year to June 2026, its lowest level since 1997 outside the pandemic, as arrivals dropped sharply — and the government claimed it had restored control of the borders.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Poundland Collapses Into Administration, Putting 11,000 Jobs at Risk Weeks Before Christmas
item.description: Poundland has collapsed into administration after failing to find a buyer, putting around 11,000 jobs and 600 stores at risk just weeks before Christmas.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Houthis Attack Saudi Arabia's Largest Refinery, Ras Tanura, as Oil Prices Jump
item.description: Yemen's Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery, Ras Tanura, and Riyadh's financial district, as satellite images showed thick black smoke over the site and Brent crude jumped 3.5% to $94.61 a barrel.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Trump Unveils New Tariffs on Fourteen Trading Partners, Rebuilding His Trade Wall on Firmer Legal Ground
item.description: The Trump administration unveiled proposed tariffs on 14 trading partners under a Section 301 probe into excess industrial capacity, with rates of up to 40% capped at levels agreed in trade deals — and a public hearing set for January.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Israeli Judges Urge Prosecutors to Drop the Bribery Case Against Netanyahu — and Rethink a Second
item.description: Judges in Jerusalem recommended prosecutors drop the bribery charge against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying a conviction was unlikely, in a major turn for a trial that began in 2020.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Wall Street's AI Sell-Off Deepens Before Thanksgiving as Nvidia Slides and Fear Spikes
item.description: Wall Street suffered another bruising session as the Nasdaq plunged as much as 4.7% before recovering, with Nvidia sliding and fear gauges spiking ahead of the Thanksgiving break.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Fuel Tanker Crash Ignites Massive Fire on Cairo's Ring Road, Killing at Least 31
item.description: At least 31 people are dead and 21 injured after a fuel tanker crashed and exploded on Cairo's Ring Road on Wednesday evening, setting fire to more than two dozen vehicles — the latest deadly crash on one of Egypt's busiest highways.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Nine Dead, 17 Trapped After Flood Swamps an Illegal Gold Mine in Indonesia
item.description: Nine miners are dead and 17 more are believed trapped after heavy rain flooded a 100-metre shaft at an unauthorised gold mine in Bogor, Indonesia — a rescue that began 16 hours late because the illegal pit was never reported.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Two More Tankers Burn in the Strait of Hormuz as Iran Vows to Tighten Its Grip — and Qatar Races to Keep Talks Alive
item.description: Two more oil tankers struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday as Iran vowed to tighten its grip on the waterway, while Qatar raced to keep US-Iran talks alive.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Nvidia's Comeback Rally Fades as Lawmakers Demand Answers on Trump's Role — and the Attorney General Dodges
item.description: Nvidia shares fell about 7 percent a day after Jensen Huang's reinstatement as lawmakers demanded answers about President Trump's role — and the attorney general dodged their questions.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: After Eight Years, a Brooklyn Jury Finds Huawei Guilty of Fraud and Trade-Secret Theft — but Not Racketeering
item.description: A Brooklyn jury convicted Huawei and three subsidiaries on 10 of 12 criminal counts, including bank fraud and conspiracy to steal trade secrets, in a case that began in 2018 — but acquitted the company of racketeering.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Xi's Purge Claims Its Biggest Name Yet: Shanghai Boss Chen Jining Under Investigation
item.description: Shanghai party chief Chen Jining, once tipped for China's top leadership, is under investigation for corruption, becoming the fourth Politburo member to fall in Xi Jinping's widening purge.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Trump Readies a New Tariff Blitz on Sixteen Trading Partners as the Old Duties Face the Courts
item.description: The Trump administration is poised to unveil new tariffs on 16 trading partners under a Section 301 probe into excess industrial capacity, partly replacing duties the Supreme Court struck down in February.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Sanofi Pays $41 Billion for Insmed in Its Biggest Bet Yet on Lung Disease
item.description: Sanofi agreed to buy the American drugmaker Insmed for $41 billion in cash on Tuesday, the biggest pharmaceutical deal in three years, as it moves to replace revenue from its blockbuster drug Dupixent before its patents expire.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Two States Sue Musk's SpaceX Over Grok's Flood of Sexualised Deepfakes
item.description: Virginia and Oregon sued Elon Musk's SpaceX on Monday, accusing Grok's 'spicy mode' of turning ordinary photographs into sexualised images, including images of children, in the first state lawsuits over the chatbot's deepfake scandal.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Eleven Days After His Fall, Jensen Huang Is Back at Nvidia — With the White House Behind Him
item.description: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive on Monday, eleven days after he resigned over revelations of extramarital affairs, after an extraordinary White House pressure campaign — and shares surged by nearly a third.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Three Tankers Burn in the Strait of Hormuz as Iran Steps Up Gulf Strikes — and Qatar Races to Revive Talks
item.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said three oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, as Tehran stepped up attacks on Gulf targets and Qatar worked to revive US-Iran talks.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya

item.title: Russian Jets Trigger a Shelter Alert on Ulleung Island — Then Seoul's Own Messages Contradict Each Other
item.description: Several Russian military aircraft entered South Korea's air defence zone near Ulleung Island on Tuesday, prompting a brief air-raid warning that was lifted within minutes — but conflicting official messages briefly told residents the planes might be North Korean.
item.dc:creator: Sezgin Baktiaya
